supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic outbound HTTPS activity is visible in proxy records: connections to updates.pixelforge-suite.com occur from 13:37:50 through 14:07:46 at roughly five-minute intervals. One attempt at 13:42:31 received proxy status 407; subsequent recorded attempts succeeded.
Endpoint network records attribute the connections to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, running as leo.martins, and show connections to the organization's explicit proxy on port 8080.

The environment inventory specifically identifies PixelForge Suite's pfupdater.exe as approved and says it checks updates.pixelforge-suite.com about every five minutes. The observed process, destination, and cadence match that documented explanation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied proxy records identify HTTPS CONNECT destinations and tunnel byte counts, but do not expose the tunneled HTTPS content; for example, the PixelForge entries are logged as proxy tunnels. (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00177, T046-00182, T046-00192, T046-00219)
The supplied process and network records identify the executable path and activity but do not establish the executable's signature, integrity, or the contents exchanged.
claims_not_established: The HTTPS tunnel contents and the exact update data exchanged are not shown in the supplied evidence.
The records do not establish the executable's signature or integrity.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26, a domain authentication record names sam.okafor from workstation WS-LMARTINS-01, and WS-SOKAFOR-01 records a network logon for sam.okafor from that workstation. This differs from the documented practice that remote administration is done only from WS-SOKAFOR-01; investigate separately, without treating it as evidence about the alerted HTTPS activity. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

FILE-NWD-01 initiated a connection to WS-LMARTINS-01 on RPC endpoint mapper port 135 during the review window. Review separately; this connection is not the alerted outbound HTTPS activity. (T046-00067, T046-00068, T046-00069)

A Dropbox updater executable ran as SYSTEM on WS-LMARTINS-01, and a nearby DNS record queried an Akamai hostname. The supplied records do not show that this process made an outbound HTTPS connection; review the software separately, without using it to decide this alert. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00124, T046-00127, T046-00128)
